name: Fortunes of Aztec

features.name: Reel-clear multiplier
features.description: Clearing all symbols from a reel adds 1x to the total win multiplier.

features.name: Tumbles
features.description: Winning symbols are replaced, enabling chain reactions.

features.name: Persistent free spins
features.description: Up to 25 free spins with multipliers that carry over between spins.

review:
A 4x6 tumble game with a clever multiplier: if every symbol on a reel gets cleared during a spin, the total win gains 1x – and that can happen several times in one spin, so long cascades get rewarded twice.

Three or more scatters give free spins, up to 25, and in the bonus your multipliers carry over between spins, so the round builds towards the end. Up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96%, a bit below Pragmatic's usual top. Feels different from the orb games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
